companies.name: イリノイ・ツール・ワークス

relations.text: 2023年にIPGフォトニクスは、ハンドヘルド溶接向けレーザー分野でMiller Electricと戦略的提携を結んだ
relations.text_en: In 2023 IPG Photonics announced a strategic partnership with Miller Electric to promote laser solutions for handheld welding

source.label: IPG Photonics の発表
source.quote: IPG Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ: IPGP), a global leader in fiber laser technology, and Miller Electric Mfg. LLC, a leading worldwide manufacturer of arc welding products, today announced a strategic partnership with a goal to further promote laser solutions for handheld welding applications.
source.note: 提携先はITWの完全子会社Miller Electricです。
source.note_en: The partner is Miller Electric, a wholly owned subsidiary of ITW.

relations.text: 提携先のMiller Electricは、Illinois Tool Worksの完全子会社である
relations.text_en: Miller Electric, the partner, is wholly owned by Illinois Tool Works

source.label: IPG Photonics の発表
source.quote: Miller Electric is headquartered in Appleton, Wisconsin, and wholly owned by Illinois Tool Works (NYSE: ITW).

source.quote: IPG Photonics, the global leader in fiber laser technology, announced today that it has received an order from Lockheed Martin Corporation for the delivery of its CROSSBOW™ high-energy laser counter-UAS defense systems.
